items.h: Processor Support: Intel Xeon E5-2600 V3 & V4 Series
Memory Support: ECC Registered / Non-ECC DDR3
Expansion Slots: PCIe x16, PCIe x4, PCIe x1

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The X99-XD3 Intel LGA 2011-V3 Server Motherboard is a dependable Micro-ATX platform built around the Intel C612 server chipset, making it an excellent choice for enterprise servers, virtualization systems, professional workstations, and high-performance computing. Designed to support Intel Xeon E5-2600 V3 and V4 processors, this motherboard delivers stable, multi-core performance for demanding business and productivity workloads.

Featuring four DDR3 DIMM slots with support for up to 128GB of quad-channel memory, the X99-XD3 is compatible with ECC Registered Server RAM, providing improved reliability for continuous 24/7 operation. Whether you're building a virtualization server, NAS, rendering workstation, or engineering system, this motherboard offers the performance and stability professionals need.

For storage, the motherboard includes dual M.2 slots (NVMe support) alongside 6 SATA III ports, allowing users to install high-speed SSDs and large-capacity HDDs simultaneously. Expansion options include PCIe x16, PCIe x4, and PCIe x1 slots, making it easy to add GPUs, RAID controllers, high-speed networking cards, or other expansion devices. Additional features such as Gigabit Ethernet, USB 3.0, USB 2.0, and HD Audio ensure broad compatibility with modern peripherals.

Key Features


  • Model: X99-XD3
  • Intel C612 Server Chipset
  • Intel LGA 2011-V3 Socket
  • Supports Intel Xeon E5-2600 V3 & V4 Processors
  • 4 × DDR3 DIMM Slots (Up to 128GB)
  • Supports ECC Registered & Non-ECC DDR3 Memory
  • Quad-Channel Memory Architecture
  • 2 × M.2 Slots (NVMe Support)
  • 6 × SATA III (6Gb/s) Ports
  • 1 × PCIe x16 Slot
  • 1 × PCIe x4 Slot
  • 1 × PCIe x1 Slot
  • Gigabit LAN (Realtek RTL8111H)
  • USB 3.0 & USB 2.0 Connectivity
  • TPM Header & M.2 Wi-Fi Slot
  • Micro-ATX Form Factor
